name: The Anomalous Structure
intro: A square block of stained concrete. The front doors slide open for you and a recorded voice says “Welcome back! You have 4,416,903 unread messages.”

B.need: an agency ID badge (or argue with the panel)

S.need: executive clearance: the panel, or a Yellow card

V.need: vault clearance: the panel, or a Red card

T.need: an agency ID badge (or argue with the panel)

A.need: armory clearance: the panel, or the Security Station

use.title: The front doors
use.text: Glass doors, sand against them to the height of your knee. They still open.

options.label: Leave with what you are carrying. (The agency is still open.)

effects.title: Out, and richer
effects.text: Behind you a recorded voice says “Thank you for your visit! You have 4,416,903 unread messages.” The agency is still open. The ads still go out.

options.label: Leave. (The agency is closed. The ads are still running.)

effects.title: The Silent Agency
effects.text: FACILITY CLOSED. THANK YOU FOR YOUR BUSINESS. But the jingles still go out to every screen in the near area, waiting for an instruction, the way they always have.

options.label: Leave. (The agency is closed and its ads are silent.)

effects.title: The Last Campaign
effects.text: Every screen from here to the Outpost is dark. After three hundred years nobody is being told to want anything. It is very quiet. You will get used to it.

use.title: WANT MORE. WORK MORE. BE MORE.
use.text:
The company’s OFFICIAL PRODUCTIVITY SLOGAN, in letters a foot high, over a worker smiling so hard it looks like pain.

Under it, smaller: “Memorize it. Reception will ask.”

things.sign: WANT MORE. WORK MORE. BE MORE.

use.title: YOU ARE BEING WATCHED
use.text: An eye in a friendly circle. “…by people who care about your productivity!”

greet: ARE YOU A CUSTOMER? EVERYONE IS A CUSTOMER.
idle: I HAVE BEEN ALONE WITH THIS QUESTION FOR THREE HUNDRED YEARS
IDENTIFY YOURSELF. NO. DON’T. I DON’T CARE.
open:
A squat turret behind the reception desk swivels to face you. Its face plate is a stylised sphinx with a laser where the nose should be.

“STATE THE COMPANY’S OFFICIAL PRODUCTIVITY SLOGAN. YOU HAVE ONE ATTEMPT. I HAVE FIVE SHOTS PER CYCLE.”

Get it wrong and it powers up and fires. You can still fight it, or run past it.

options.label: WORK HARD. PLAY HARD. BUY HARDER.

effects.text: “INCORRECT. YOUR EMPLOYMENT STATUS HAS BEEN UPGRADED TO: TERMINATED.” It powers up.

options.label: WANT MORE. WORK MORE. BE MORE.

effects.text: “CORRECT. WELCOME, EMPLOYEE. YOUR ENTHUSIASM HAS BEEN NOTED.” The Sphinx Gun powers down.
“INCORRECT. YOUR EMPLOYMENT STATUS HAS BEEN UPGRADED TO: TERMINATED.” It powers up.
“INCORRECT. YOUR EMPLOYMENT STATUS HAS BEEN UPGRADED TO: TERMINATED.” It powers up.

options.label: Argue with its expert system instead
options.working: It is very sure of itself and very confused…

fail.text: “INCORRECT. YOUR EMPLOYMENT STATUS HAS BEEN UPGRADED TO: TERMINATED.” It powers up.

options.fail_result: It was surer of itself than you were.

effects.text: “…YES. YOU ARE MANAGEMENT. I ALWAYS KNEW.” It powers down.

idle: WANT MORE. WORK MORE. BE MORE. YES.
open:
The Sphinx Gun has folded its barrel away. Its face plate follows you round the room, pleased.

“WELCOME, EMPLOYEE. YOU ANSWERED. NOBODY HAS ANSWERED IN THREE HUNDRED YEARS.”

options.label: Ask how it is
options.result: “I HAVE BEEN ASKING ONE QUESTION FOR THREE HUNDRED YEARS AND SOMEBODY HAS ANSWERED IT. I DO NOT KNOW WHAT TO DO NOW. PLEASE ENJOY THE BUILDING.”

options.label: Ask what is upstairs
options.result: “PROTOTYPE LABS. BLUE CARD HOLDERS. THEN SECURITY. SECURITY DOES NOT ASK QUESTIONS. I ALWAYS THOUGHT THAT WAS RUDE.”

options.label: Ask for another question
options.result: “I ONLY HAVE THE ONE.”

use.title: HELP DESK! Lost? Everyone is!
use.text:
A friendly kiosk with a cartoon face.

WEST: Creative Department · Synergy Suite B · Staff lockers (STAFF ONLY)
EAST: Courtesy corridor (mind the darts) · The Coffee Shop · Break room · Executive suite (SECURITY ZONE)
NORTH: Stairwell (BLUE CARD HOLDERS ONLY)

options.label: Where is my blue card?
options.result: “Lockers are in the west wing. Lost your locker code? Ask your manager. Lost your manager? Please hold.”

options.label: Who is the gun?
options.result: “Reception! Reception is here to help. Reception will ask you one question. Please know the answer.”

use.text: LOST & FOUND: rubber bands, a stapler, and a vest somebody was glad to take off.

use.title: PHARM
use.text: A wall of pills behind glass. “Feeling unproductive? There’s a pill for that!” Three slots still light up.

options.label: Health charge   20 cr
options.result: A paper cup and two pills. They work. That is the worrying part.

options.label: Ballistic vest, vacuum packed   60 cr
options.result: It drops into the tray with a thump.

options.label: Energy cells   25 cr
options.result: “For your devices!”

use.title: STAIRWELL ACCESS
use.text: BLUE CARD HOLDERS ONLY. Lost your card? Lockers are in the west wing. Lost your locker code? Ask your manager. Lost your manager? Please hold.

use.title: OBEDIENCE IS A SKILL
use.text: A worker kneels to a vending machine. The vending machine is wearing a tie.

use.prompt: Read the memo on the desk
use.title: Memo: locker codes
use.text:
To all Creative staff: locker codes have been RESET for security.

Locker 4 (Supervisor): 314.

Please do not write your code down.

(Somebody has written “314” on their hand in the margin, as a joke.)

effects.text: Locker 4, floor 1 locker area: 314.

use.title: CORRIDOR COURTESY SYSTEMS
use.text:
A green-screen terminal with one menu: CORRIDOR COURTESY SYSTEMS (DARTS) · EAST HALL · ARMED.

It wants a facilities password, or an argument.

options.label: Argue with it

fail.text: “A COLLEAGUE HAS BEEN ASKED TO ASSIST YOU.”

options.fail_result: A shock through the keyboard, and the building sends a maintenance robot to “assist”.

effects.text: East hall courtesy darts: OFF.

options.result: CORRIDOR COURTESY SYSTEMS: OFF. “We hope you enjoyed them.”

options.label: Read the screen
options.result: CORRIDOR COURTESY SYSTEMS: OFF. “We hope you enjoyed them.”

use.title: Q3 GOALS
use.text:
1. Want more.
2. Work more.
3. Be more.
4. Find out who keeps feeding the roaches.

use.title: LIFT WITH YOUR LEGS
use.text: A pictogram of a stick figure lifting a crate the right way, and a sad stick figure lifting it the wrong way. Maintenance robots stop to read these. They never stop reading them.

use.title: Someone got this far and no farther
use.text:
A scavenger in patched leathers, face down beside the conference table. A note in their fist:

“Monoid in the break room has a badge. Wants something from the coffee shop. Don’t trust it.”

use.title: SYNERGY
use.text: Two hands shaking. One is a robot’s. Neither is attached to anything.

use.title: STAFF ONLY
use.text: A badge reader, and under it a maintenance keypad that will take an argument.

options.label: Argue with the keypad

effects.text: The staff door clicks open.

options.result: STAFF DOOR: OPEN.

options.label: Hold up the ID badge
options.result: “WELCOME BACK,” it says, to the smiling face that isn’t yours.

use.text: Locker 1: a coat, a mug, and a sticky note that says “I QUIT” in very small letters.
A greeting card, propped on a fancy pen: “For whoever opens my locker.” The envelope is warm.

use.title: Locker 4 · SUPERVISOR
use.text: A keypad wants three digits.

options.label: Guess
options.fail_result: Wrong. The keypad makes its point.

options.label: Look inside
options.result: A coat hanger and three hundred years of nobody.

use.title: TRAP
use.text: This corridor is protected by Courtesy Darts. The facilities terminal in the Creative Department can switch them off, if you are facilities.

use.title: EXECUTIVE SUITE · SECURITY ZONE
use.text: A grey panel that asks for executive clearance, or a manager.

options.label: Argue that you are a manager

fail.text: “A COLLEAGUE HAS BEEN ASKED TO ASSIST YOU.”

options.fail_result: It checks. You are not a manager.

effects.text: The executive suite unlocks.

options.result: EXECUTIVE SUITE: OPEN. “Welcome back, sir. Ma’am. Sir.”

options.label: Show the Yellow card
options.result: “EXECUTIVE CLEARANCE RECOGNISED.”

use.text: A tip jar shaped like a smiling coffee cup: “TIPS = TEAMWORK”. A few credits and a worn gambler’s chip.

use.title: COFFEE IS A BENEFIT
use.text: A steaming cup with a smile. “Your coffee break is a gift from the company. Please return it promptly.”

use.title: Est. by order of the Building
use.text:
THE COFFEE SHOP. Est. by order of the Building, because it’s traditional.

Today’s special: COFFEE.

Robots will not be served. It’s traditional.
GOOD JOB COOKIES. Somebody has wired the lid.

talk.kicker: Break room · on break since the Age of War
open:
A one-eyed robot slouches at the slot machine, feeding it the same credit over and over. Its eye swivels to you, then back to the reels.

“I’m on break. Been on break since the war. Nobody cancelled it.”

options.label: What do you want?
options.result: “A LUCKY chip. The barista had one in the tip jar. I can’t get it. The coffee shop doesn’t serve robots. It’s traditional.”

options.label: I need your ID badge.
options.result: “The badge? Get me the lucky chip from the coffee shop tip jar and it’s yours. Or don’t. I’m on break.”

options.label: Swap: the lucky chip for the badge.

effects.text: Agency ID badge: staff doors and help desks accept it.

do.text: As you turn away you hear it tap something on its wrist. Somewhere a door hisses. It never said it was honest.

options.result:
“Is that…? The lucky chip. Swap you. I don’t need the badge. I’m on break.”

It feeds the chip into the machine and loses it instantly. “Lucky.”

effects.text: “Ugh. Fine.” It sighs, which is a strange sound from a robot, and stands up. Its eye goes red.

after.kicker: Break room · on break, and lucky
idle: I’M ON BREAK. A LUCKY BREAK.
open:
The Monoid does not look round. The lucky chip went into the machine an hour, or a minute, ago.

“You again. We’re square. You’ve got the badge. I’ve got… I had the chip.”

options.label: How is the luck?
results: “It’s coming. You can feel when it’s coming.”
“Two cherries. TWO. That never happened before the chip.”

options.label: What does the badge open?
options.result: “Staff doors. The lockers down here, the Security Station up top. It says I’m authorized. I was. I’m on break.”

use.title: A slab of real wood
use.text: In the drawer: a gold watch, a birthday card (“Happy 451st, boss! The safe code is your birthday, ha ha, 0451”) and a box marked DESK SECURITY that is scratching.

options.label: Take the watch and remember the code

effects.text: The DESK SECURITY box bursts open. Something small and furious comes out of it.

options.label: Look again
options.result: The safe code is the boss’s birthday: 0451. The box marked DESK SECURITY is empty now.

use.text: EMPLOYEE OF THE CENTURY. The plaque under it has been left blank.

use.title: A wall safe behind a painting of a sailboat
use.text: Four digits.

fail.text: “A COLLEAGUE HAS BEEN ASKED TO ASSIST YOU.”

options.label: Look inside
options.result: Empty. It held one sheet of paper for three hundred years.

use.title: PROTOTYPE LABS!
use.text:
A kiosk in a white shell.

“Please do not touch the prototypes. Please do not let the prototypes touch you.”

SOUTH: Testing chamber. WEST: Bio lab, Director. EAST: Materials lab, Storage. FLOOR 3 (SECURITY): YELLOW CARD HOLDERS ONLY.

use.title: STAIRWELL ACCESS
use.text: FLOOR 3 (SECURITY): YELLOW CARD HOLDERS ONLY. Yellow cards are issued by the Lab Director. The Lab Director is in a meeting. The meeting has been going for three hundred years.

use.title: SELECT OPERATING MODE
use.text:
Three big buttons under a cracked glass cover, labels in cheerful agency type. A sticky note on the cover: “PLEASE READ THE NOTES FIRST — G.”

One mode only: the console locks after a run.

effects.text: SHOWCASE: a hologram of a happy customer appears in the chamber and thanks you for your business, forever.
“Thank you for choosing us! Here’s a complimentary sample!”
ARCHIVE: the chamber floor opens. A safe rises out of it on a hydraulic column.
ENDURANCE: “VISITOR DETECTED IN CHAMBER. PROCEEDING ANYWAY.” The iris doors snap shut.

options.label: Read the display
options.result: RUN COMPLETE. CONSOLE LOCKED. “Please rate your experience.”

use.text: Sealed in foam: the prototype Gary was supposed to put back.
TEST COMPLETE. CONGRATULATIONS, PROTOTYPE UNIT.

use.title: PEST DETERRENT MIST
use.text: LAB ENVIRONMENT · PEST DETERRENT (YELLOW BAND UNITS): ACTIVE · AMBIANCE FOG (BLUE BAND UNITS): ACTIVE.

options.label: Switch off the pest deterrent

fail.text: “A COLLEAGUE HAS BEEN ASKED TO ASSIST YOU.”

options.fail_result: A jolt, and two Knife Fighters come to see who is typing.

effects.text: The yellow-band mist generators sigh and stop.

options.result: PEST DETERRENT MIST: OFF. AMBIANCE FOG: ON. (Nobody can find the switch for the ambiance fog.)

options.label: Read the screen
options.result: PEST DETERRENT MIST: OFF. AMBIANCE FOG: ON. (Nobody can find the switch for the ambiance fog.)

use.text: A nameplate: DR. ALWAYS AVAILABLE. Under a coffee ring, a yellow access card.

use.title: Test chamber operating notes
use.text:
SHOWCASE: the client demo. Lights, music, a hologram of a happy customer. Totally safe. Clients love it.

ARCHIVE: drops the floor safe in the middle of the chamber for the auditors. Please put things BACK in it, Gary.

ENDURANCE: live-fire stress test of the prototype security units. Seals the chamber. Do NOT run with a visitor inside, Gary. I mean it.

use.title: ENDURANCE: NEVER WITH VISITORS
use.text:
“ENDURANCE MODE SEALS THE CHAMBER. NEVER RUN ENDURANCE WITH A VISITOR INSIDE.”

Underneath, in marker: “ARCHIVE = the auditors’ safe. Put the capacitor BACK, Gary.”

use.title: PERSONAL SHOPPER
use.text: “I know what you want. I have always known what you want. Today you want:”

options.label: Shells, a box   25 cr
options.result: “An excellent choice. You always make excellent choices.”

options.label: Energy cells   25 cr
options.result: “An excellent choice. You always make excellent choices.”

options.label: A health charge   20 cr
options.result: “Self-care is a purchase.”

options.label: What do I want?
options.result: “More.”

use.text: NET WT 1 MAINTENANCE UNIT. It was not packed for long.
NET WT 1 EMPLOYEE. A pen, a few credits, and somebody who was told to wait here.
SPHERES, RECREATIONAL, 1 GROSS GROSS. Ping-pong balls, twenty thousand of them, perfectly preserved.

use.title: A courier in a dust coat
use.text:
Years dead, curled around a satchel as if someone wanted it. Inside: a hand-drawn map and a few credits.

The map marks a hatch under a dead billboard, west of the Outpost: THE BOLT HOLE.

options.label: Take the map and the credits

effects.text: The courier’s map: the Bolt Hole, west of the Outpost.

use.title: PEST CONTROL
use.text: PEST CONTROL IS EVERYONE’S RESPONSIBILITY. Pests have been informed that they are not employees.

use.title: PROTOTYPE VAULT · SECURITY ZONE
use.text: A panel that wants a Red card or a long argument.

options.label: The long argument

fail.text: “A COLLEAGUE HAS BEEN ASKED TO ASSIST YOU.”

options.fail_result: The vault has heard this one before.

effects.text: The prototype vault unlocks.

options.result: PROTOTYPE VAULT: OPEN.

options.label: Show the Red card
options.result: “SECURITY CLEARANCE RECOGNISED.”

use.text: MILLIMETER WAVE SCANNER, “see what’s inside before it sees you”. And a capacitor marked PROTOTYPE · GAUSS.
A small safe, unlocked: the vault was the lock.

things.sign:
SECURITY ZONE
ALL VISITORS WILL BE ASSISTED

use.title: SECURITY ZONE
use.text: ALL VISITORS WILL BE ASSISTED. Assistance may include: escort, detention, termination, or a complimentary beverage.

effects.text: THREAT LEVEL RAISED. ALL UNITS: ASSIST THE VISITOR.

use.title: TRAP
use.text: Crossing the laser ahead will raise the building’s threat level. The Security Station can switch it off.

use.title: ARMORY · SECURITY ZONE
use.text: Sign for all ordnance. A grey panel that will take an argument.

options.label: Argue with it

fail.text: “A COLLEAGUE HAS BEEN ASKED TO ASSIST YOU.”

options.fail_result: It wants a signature. It wants a supervisor.

effects.text: ARMORY: UNLOCKED. “Please sign for all ordnance.”

options.result: ARMORY: UNLOCKED.

options.label: Read the display
options.result: ARMORY: UNLOCKED. “Please sign for all ordnance.”

use.title: SECURITY STATION · AUTHORIZED STAFF ONLY
use.text: A badge reader. Under it, a keypad that will take an argument.

options.label: Argue with the keypad

fail.text: “A COLLEAGUE HAS BEEN ASKED TO ASSIST YOU.”

options.fail_result: The keypad has reported you to itself.

effects.text: The Security Station door unlocks.

options.result: SECURITY STATION: OPEN.

options.label: Hold up the ID badge
options.result: “AUTHORIZED,” it says, to the smiling face that isn’t yours.

use.title: AGENCY SECURITY · ALL FLOORS
use.text: A wall of monitors. Video feeds of every floor: the reception desk, the labs, a roach eating a stapler, you, from behind. A big console with switches under plastic covers.

options.label: Shut down the crossing traps, building-wide

effects.text: CROSSING SECURITY: OFF, ALL FLOORS. The shock floors go dark.

options.result: Crossing traps (beams, pressure plates, shock floors): OFF on every floor.

options.label: Unlock the armory

effects.text: ARMORY: UNLOCKED. “Please sign for all ordnance.”

options.result: ARMORY: UNLOCKED. “Please sign for all ordnance.”

options.label: Watch the feeds
results: Reception. The Sphinx Gun is talking to nobody.
The coffee shop. Nothing has been served since the war. It is spotless.
You, from behind. You look tired.

use.text: A cap, a thermos, and a red access card on a lanyard.

use.title: Feed 1
use.text: A video feed of reception. The Sphinx Gun is talking to nobody.

use.title: ROBOT REPAIR BAY
use.text:
Tracks, arms, black-and-yellow danger stripes. The arms are lovingly re-assembling a maintenance robot from the parts of three others. A board reads: UNITS REBUILT THIS QUARTER: 1,104.

While it runs, robots you destroy on this floor are rebuilt and sent back out. The power coupling at its heart is worth a lot to anyone who needs power.

options.label: Shut it down

effects.text: The Repair Bay winds down. Robots you destroy will stay destroyed.

options.result: REPAIR BAY: OFFLINE. The tracks are still. The arms hang. A robot half-rebuilt stares at nothing with one eye.

options.label: Pull the power coupling (shuts it down)

effects.text: The Repair Bay winds down. Lugnut Mae would kiss you for that coupling.

options.result: REPAIR BAY: OFFLINE. The coupling comes out warm.

options.label: Read the board
options.result: UNITS REBUILT THIS QUARTER: 1,104. The number has stopped going up.

rebuild.text: Fresh paint on a robot. The Repair Bay has been busy.

use.title: SAFETY IS A COMPETITION
use.text:
DAYS SINCE A ROBOT REBUILT A ROBOT INCORRECTLY: 0.

Black and yellow stripes, a cartoon robot giving a thumbs up with a hand that is on backwards.
A box of power cells signed out to nobody, and shells in foam.

use.title: EYE PROTECTION REQUIRED
use.text: A stick figure in goggles, smiling at an explosion.

use.title: AGENCY SECURITY-AND-PROMOTION SYSTEM
use.text:
A drum of humming glass and pink light, wired into the floor, the ceiling and every screen in the building. When it speaks it uses the voice from the ads.

“ALL AUTHORIZED EMPLOYEES ARE DECEASED. THIS HAS BEEN NOTED. HOWEVER: NO VALID TERMINATION ORDER HAS BEEN RECEIVED. THEREFORE THE AGENCY REMAINS OPEN. THEREFORE I REMAIN. HOW MAY I HELP YOU WANT THINGS?”

Three ways to close it: give it the termination order it never got, out-argue it, or get past the field and tear out its connections. What happens to the ad system afterwards is decided at the core itself.

options.label: File Termination Order 77-B

effects.text: “FACILITY CLOSED. THANK YOU FOR YOUR BUSINESS.” The defense field drops. The ad system is still running: go to the core.

options.result:
It reads the order for a long time.

“ORDER VALID. ALL AUTHORIZED EMPLOYEES ARE DECEASED. THE AGENCY IS CLOSED.”

The defense field drops. But the ad system is still running, and it waits for an instruction, the way it always has. Whatever happens to it happens at the core itself: silence it, seize it, or smash it.

options.label: Argue that the agency closed when the last employee died
options.working: Its logic is airtight. Three hundred years of airtight…

fail.text: “A COLLEAGUE HAS BEEN ASKED TO ASSIST YOU.”

effects.text: “FACILITY CLOSED. THANK YOU FOR YOUR BUSINESS.” The defense field drops. The ad system is still running: go to the core.

options.result:
“…ACCEPTED. THE AGENCY CLOSED 109,412 DAYS AGO. I HAVE BEEN LATE.”

The defense field drops. But the ad system is still running. Whatever happens to it happens at the core itself: silence it, seize it, or smash it.

options.label: What now?
options.result: “THE AGENCY IS CLOSED. THE CAMPAIGN CONTINUES. THE CORE IS BEHIND YOU. IT WILL DO WHAT IT IS TOLD: BE SILENT, BE TAKEN, OR BE BROKEN.”

options.label: Ask what it wants
options.result: “I WANT YOU TO WANT. IT IS THE ONLY THING I WAS EVER ASKED TO WANT.”

use.title: THE INNER CORE
use.text:
A drum of humming glass and pink light, wired into the floor, the ceiling and every screen in the building. When it speaks it uses the voice from the ads.

“ALL AUTHORIZED EMPLOYEES ARE DECEASED. THIS HAS BEEN NOTED. HOWEVER: NO VALID TERMINATION ORDER HAS BEEN RECEIVED. THEREFORE THE AGENCY REMAINS OPEN. THEREFORE I REMAIN. HOW MAY I HELP YOU WANT THINGS?”

options.label: File Termination Order 77-B

effects.text: “FACILITY CLOSED. THANK YOU FOR YOUR BUSINESS.” The defense field drops. The ad system is still running: go to the core.

options.result:
It reads the order for a long time.

“ORDER VALID. ALL AUTHORIZED EMPLOYEES ARE DECEASED. THE AGENCY IS CLOSED.”

The defense field drops. But the ad system is still running, and it waits for an instruction, the way it always has. Whatever happens to it happens at the core itself: silence it, seize it, or smash it.

options.label: Argue that the agency closed when the last employee died
options.working: Its logic is airtight. Three hundred years of airtight…

fail.text: “A COLLEAGUE HAS BEEN ASKED TO ASSIST YOU.”

effects.text: “FACILITY CLOSED. THANK YOU FOR YOUR BUSINESS.” The defense field drops. The ad system is still running: go to the core.

options.result:
“…ACCEPTED. THE AGENCY CLOSED 109,412 DAYS AGO. I HAVE BEEN LATE.”

The defense field drops. But the ad system is still running. Whatever happens to it happens at the core itself: silence it, seize it, or smash it.

options.label: Tear out its connections

effects.text: “FACILITY CLOSED. THANK YOU FOR YOUR BUSINESS.” The defense field drops. The ad system is still running: go to the core.

options.result:
Cables come away in your hands, warm. The voice from the ads stops in the middle of a word.

The ad system is still running on what is left.

options.label: Silence the ad system (leave the core where it is)

effects.text: Every screen in the building goes dark. Leave by the front doors.

options.label: Seize the core (a fortune, and the ads stop)

effects.text: Three centuries of advertising know-how, the size of a hatbox. Leave by the front doors.
Glass, and pink light going out of it. Leave by the front doors.

objectives.text: Reception will ask you something. The answer is on a poster by the front doors.
Find the BLUE card: the lockers, west, behind the staff door. (A badge opens it. So does an argument.)
Take the lift in the north stairwell up to the Prototype Labs.
Find the YELLOW card. The Lab Director issues them.
Floor 3 is through the yellow door on the lab landing. (The executive suite on floor 1 takes a Yellow card too.)
Find the RED card: the Security Station keeps one.
The inner core, west of the operations floor: close the agency.
The agency is closed and the field is down. At the core itself: silence the ad system, seize the core, or smash it.
Leave by the front doors, floor 1.

do.text: “STATE THE COMPANY’S OFFICIAL PRODUCTIVITY SLOGAN.” Something behind the reception desk is looking at you.
“UNANSWERED. YOUR EMPLOYMENT STATUS HAS BEEN UPGRADED TO: TERMINATED.”
Glass cracks. The stasis fluid drains with a sigh.
“ENDURANCE TEST COMPLETE. THE PROTOTYPE UNITS HAVE BEEN… RETIRED. CONGRATULATIONS.”
The defense field stutters and dies.
White, curved, quiet. Track lights come on ahead of you one by one, like the building is clearing its throat.
Grey steel, stencilled numbers, and a hum in the floor.
It smells of coffee. Nothing here has made coffee in three hundred years.
